status: attributable background activity inside the recorded attack datasets
not_a_clean_baseline: These recordings are adversary-emulation captures. The records listed here were attributed to ordinary Windows or vendor activity using fields present in the record itself. They are not a separately collected clean environment, they are not exhaustive, and they are not a substitute for one. A client deployment must collect its own baseline before relying on any false-positive rate in this file.

benign_groups.attribution: Sysmon event 10 handles to lsass.exe opened by svchost.exe whose call trace resolves to lsm.dll, the logon session manager, or sysmain.dll, the memory compression driver. Both run on every sign-in and under memory pressure.

Security 5140 and 5145 share events on the SYSVOL administrative share by the machine account MORDORDC$ for gpt.ini group policy template files. This is ordinary Group Policy replication on a domain controller.

Security 4624 logons of type 3 by the machine account MORDORDC$ on the domain controller MORDORDC.theshire.local. Machine logons dominate type 3 on any busy domain controller. These records are on a different host from the attack evidence and the two host names are deliberately not merged; the comparison is valid because the rule logic is host agnostic, and it is stated this way so that no same-host relationship is implied.
Sysmon event 1 creation of OfficeC2RClient.exe under the Click-to-Run shared folder, parented by svchost.exe, following a recorded scheduled task registration. Vendor update activity.
